lists.title: Strongest UR units (high difficulty)
about: This is Game8's main tier table for UR units (including their EX forms) in high-difficulty content. It has 89 units. Tiers run from SSS (Tier 0) down to D (Tier 6). Higher-tier units have better firepower or survivability and can be used in more quests.

Each role is judged on its own terms. Attack units are rated on single-hit damage. Support units are rated on how many range-5 debuff weapons they carry and on their abilities. Defense units are rated on shields, damage reduction and similar defensive tools.
Some units rate differently in the Master League (PvP), so this list is for PvE.
notes: New: Reborns Gundam (UR, Support) is SSS for high difficulty and SS in the Master League. It is time-limited and only drops from the Reborns & Dynames banner.
New: Gundam Dynames (UR, Attack) is S in both high difficulty and the Master League.
Best Attack units: Gundam F91 (Twin V.S.B.R.), God Gundam and Wing Gundam Zero (EW). They stand out for raw damage, first-hit negation and MAP weapons usable after moving.
Best Defense unit: 00 Raiser (Final Battle). Best Support units: Altron Gundam (EW), Zanspine and Reborns Gundam.
Best in Master League Season 17: Gundam F91 (Twin V.S.B.R.) and Gundam Barbatos Lupus Rex.

D.n: Gundam Astray Gold Frame Amatsu Mina

lists.title: Strongest SSR units (development & events)
about: Game8's ranking of SSR-rarity units. Useful for picking which SSRs to build before you have many EX or UR units.
Game8 splits this ranking in two. This tab covers units you get from Development or events. Gacha SSRs are on the SSR gacha tab.
Game8 only edits the tier table, the article text and the unit's own review together, and only when a role tier actually changes.
notes: The top SSS tier is unchanged this update.
New: GM Sniper II (White Dingo Team) and Extreme Gundam Excelia enter at S. GM Sniper II carries a range-5 weapon that lowers enemy attack, which makes it easy to use.
New: Graham's Union Flag Custom II (GN Flag) enters at A. Gelgoog Ground Type (Visch Donahue) and Rhinosaurus Type B enter at B.

lists.title: Best units to develop
about: Priority list for regular and event Development (turning units you own into new ones through the development tree).
Develop high-firepower Attack units first, such as 00 Raiser (Final Battle) and Phenex (Destroy Mode). If you are short on damage dealers, work through Tier 0 first.
Units with wide-area MAP weapons are also strong picks, so check whether a target has one before you develop it.
notes: New: GM Sniper II (White Dingo Team) is recommended because of its range-5 attack-down debuff weapon.
Ultimate Development has its own short list. Open the Ultimate tab to see it.

A.n: Full Armor Knight Gundam (Two Sacred Treasures)

about: Which units to SP-upgrade first. Game8 ranks Attack, Support and Defense units in separate tables; here they share one tier list, Attack first in each tier. Use the type filter to see one role.
Rarity tags are left off on this list because Game8 doesn't show them here.
notes: Four units were added through the Mobile Suit Gundam Side Story 0079: Rise from the Ashes event and the Gundam 00 Story Challenge.
